items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: resume some old friendships down there with some of the other guys, such as Professor Manuel Monnetto

ctx.x: Yes, and I'm going to sit in with him when I get down there on a few of the jazz numbers. And I'm going to sit in with him.

I know that I'm going to resume some old friendships down there with some of the other guys, such as Professor Manuel Monnetto over in Al Jays and most of these other fellows that I know around there that knew me.
